_comment: The two-host pool with the RTX 3050 laptop: the laptop (hostname fedora) is the harness host on .1 and also runs the GTX 1650 Ti node; the Dell RTX 3050 6GB laptop boots from the Crucial X9 as hostname rtx3050 on .12. client_endpoint is the port the replay client binds for F-11 deliveries; it must be reachable INBOUND from every worker host, which is the check nothing else performs. Both nodes run the 1B model because F-9 holds engine, model and quant constant across pool members.
